# net4sats Captive Portal

> A captive portal website for [net4sats](https://net4sats.com). This portal allows users to paste a Cashu token or pay with BTC Lightning to gain internet access.

Language: TypeScript/JavaScript
Repository: https://github.com/net4sats/net4sats-captive-portal-site.git
Local path: /home/c03rad0r/repos/net4sats-captive-portal-site

## Notes for AI Assistants
This is the **net4sats Captive Portal** project written in TypeScript/JavaScript.
Purpose: A captive portal website for [net4sats](https://net4sats.com). This portal allows users to paste a Cashu token or pay with BTC Lightning to gain internet access.
Read README.md for full documentation. Key configuration and entry points are listed in Quick Links above.
